assumptions.statement: Official planning boundary, road redlines, FAR, height, ownership, utilities, heritage controls and surveyed existing buildings are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All spatial moves remain conceptual and all precision-sensitive metrics must be recalculated.

assumptions.statement: Repository provisional rough SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are used for generation and intake checks only.
assumptions.impact: They cannot support approval, statutory zoning or precise area claims.

assumptions.statement: AI services provide bounded advice or tests with human review, data minimisation, logs and exit mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: Operational pilots require separate legal, cybersecurity, privacy and accessibility assessment.
